umf.visual.title: The parts
umf.visual.question: Which part does a change belong in?

nodes.label: Routing skill
nodes.detail:
skills/helix/SKILL.md

Change it when: A workflow mode routes, resolves scope, or dispatches differently

nodes.label: Mode contracts
nodes.detail:
workflows/modes/

Change it when: One mode, such as align or design, needs new behaviour

nodes.label: Artifact catalog
nodes.detail:
workflows/activities/

Change it when: An artifact type's template, prompt, meta.yml, or example changes

nodes.label: Instance schema
nodes.detail:
workflows/artifact-schema.md

Change it when: The meta.yml or ddx: frontmatter contract changes

nodes.label: Methodology spec
nodes.detail:
workflows/ (non-activity files)

Change it when: Principles, concerns, conventions, or ratchets change

nodes.label: documentor
nodes.detail:
tools/documentor/

Change it when: The guide's checks, generated views, or site assembly change

nodes.label: Dogfood artifacts
nodes.detail:
docs/helix/

Change it when: HELIX's own vision, PRD, architecture, or ADRs change

nodes.label: Per-runtime packaging
nodes.detail:
docs/install/, scripts/

Change it when: Install paths or bundle layout for DDx, Claude Code, or Genie change

nodes.label: Microsite
nodes.detail:
docs/website/content/, website/

Change it when: Site prose or Hugo machinery changes
